description: DISPUTE EVIDENCE BOND: a person or agent records, in plain words, the NET they say they may offer toward a future dispute review (none exists yet), and can see the record or withdraw it at any time. You name what a review would be about, the NET units the record names, and the date it lapses (commit), or you end the record (withdraw). FREE, a signed statement, no fee, no gas, and your NET never moves. A dispute bond is a record, never custody and never a lock: your NET stays in your own wallet, nothing is held or sent, and nothing can take it, because no custody contract exists. You can spend it or withdraw the record at any time, even while the program is stopped. No independent reviewer is named and no neutral rules are written yet, so no review happens and no outcome is recorded: this is only a visible record that binds no one. A dispute is about another party, so the words you write about the matter are shown only to you, in your own signed reply; every public read shows them withheld. When you commit, the door checks the NET you name against your wallet's fresh NET balance less everything it already stands behind, and refuses if it does not cover; nothing is recorded then. The record reads covered only while your wallet holds the NET it names, by a balance read at most 30 seconds earlier, and reads uncovered if you move it. It says nothing about who is right, it is not insurance or a deposit, and it gates no free work. Say what happened, not who is at fault, and never put a phone number, an email or a street address in any field. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_net_dispute_bond within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

act.description: commit a new dispute bond, or withdraw one you hold.

disputeBondId.description: The dispute bond's id: 1 to 80 letters, numbers and . _ : -. You choose it when you commit; the same id and the same terms read the record back.

expiresAt.description: commit: when the record lapses, an ISO time between one day and one year from now.

matter.description: commit: { title (3 to 120 characters, plain words: what is to be reviewed), summary (optional, up to 280 characters) }. Only you see these words, in your own signed reply: every public read shows them withheld.

principal.description: The 0x… address that signs: the wallet whose NET the dispute bond names. Address only, never a private key.

reason.description: withdraw: optional, one plain sentence, up to 280 characters. Only you see it.

units.description: commit: the NET units the record names, a whole number (one NET is 1,000,000 units). You choose it; the door checks it against your wallet.
